content.scenario: A District Commission is hearing a case, and the President and a member differ on a point. They refer the point to another member for hearing.
content.outcome: The other member shall give their opinion on the referred point within a period of one month from the date of such reference.

user_queries: What happens when members of a District Commission differ in opinion?
How long does the other member have to give their opinion?
Can the reference be made to more than one member?
